description: This file contains analysis functions and classes related to PyTorch's AOT Autograd implementation, including metadata manipulation, graph signature creation, and tensor aliasing analysis, specific to the _functorch/input_output_analysis.py module.

classes.name: ViewAndMutationMeta
classes.description: Metadata class representing view and mutation information for tensors in AOT autograd analysis.

classes.name: InputAliasInfo
classes.description: Class representing aliasing information of tensor inputs.

classes.name: OutputAliasInfo
classes.description: Class representing aliasing information of outputs.

classes.name: GraphSignature
classes.description: Class encapsulating the graph's signature including input/output specs and metadata.

methods.name: ViewAndMutationMeta remove_dupe_metadata( m: ViewAndMutationMeta, keep_arg_mask: list[bool], add_dupe_map: list[int], )
methods.description: Removes duplicate metadata entries from ViewAndMutationMeta for optimized analysis.

methods.name: tuple[ViewAndMutationMeta,list[int]] create_synthetic_base_metadata( m: ViewAndMutationMeta, synthetic_base_info: list[Union[int, tuple[int, torch.Tensor]]], outer_args: list[Any], inner_args: list[Any], inner_args_desc: list[AOTInput], )
methods.description: Constructs metadata for functions with synthetic base arguments, updating input/output info accordingly.

methods.name: compute_overlapping_inputs(aot_config, fwd_inputs, aliased_input_indices)
methods.description: Determines which inputs overlap (alias) via storage, applying guard logic if needed.

methods.name: GraphSignature create_graph_signature( fx_g: torch.fx.GraphModule, fw_metadata: ViewAndMutationMeta, in_spec: pytree.TreeSpec, out_spec: pytree.TreeSpec, *, user_args_flat: list[Tensor], params_and_buffers_flat: list[Tensor], param_names: list[str], buffer_names: list[str], trace_joint: bool, num_user_fw_outs: Optional[int], loss_index: Optional[int], )
methods.description: Generates a graph signature object from FX graph and metadata, including input/output names and backward info.
